title: Expire stale invitations automatically and notify the requester

outcomes.statement: The scheduled hygiene job withdraws eligible pending invitations after an explicitly enabled configurable expiry window, releases the seat reservation and re-notifies the requester exactly once with a durable action trail.
outcomes.demo: Configure expiry, advance an injected clock, run the job twice and verify one invitation-only deletion, one lifecycle transition, one requester notification and one visible action; accepted, foreign-company, disabled and not-yet-due invitations remain untouched.

uncertainties.statement: Expiry key, default and validation semantics are now canonical.
uncertainties.resolution: DEC-SMP-023 in docs/decisions/DECISION_MATRIX.md and US-069 AC1 require AlertRule(type=invite_unaccepted).threshold.auto_withdraw_after_hours: null disables automatic expiry; a configured integer must be strictly greater than threshold.hours. Reject invalid values in a shared validator owned by US-069 and later reused by US-044. Rule seed/record configuration is sufficient until US-044; no settings UI is included. This replaces the parent proposal wording that allowed a window equal to the alert threshold.

uncertainties.statement: Scheduled service composition and exactly-once notification evidence depend on US-068 delivery.
uncertainties.resolution: Post-US-068 assessment against canonical dev_done27f31a1/sourcea4169fa: reuse canonical UUID original-action session lock, committed intent, strict receipt recovery and same-client production factory. Add optional same-client fresh-intent eligibility guard and transactional completion hook to shared service, retaining manual behavior. Compose after delivery/membership in existing invitePoll with existing runtime lifecycle notification drain, no new schedule/loop. Shared expiry validator normalizes legacy missing key to disabled and requires configured finite integer strictly greater than hours; narrow numeric evaluator reads without unrelated alert changes. Dedicated decision/deprovisioned requester notice is atomically enqueued before final COMMIT with original invitation/requester dedupe; durable receipt supports no-network recovery after rule disable or enqueue rollback, preserving manual attribution and stored automatic note across locale changes. Real PostgreSQL/domain/outbox/crypto/provider composition and Pact-backed HTTP plus production mailer/local SMTP server prove two-run delivery and system trail. Exact17 source/test paths plus readiness/combined design-plan/feedback=20, no spare; original automatic-invite-expiry280 estimate unchanged. Embed complete child design in the readiness-bound plan path, commit design before executable task plan; no separate extra path. Expected9 shards remain provisional until ordinary discovery. No migration/dependency/tooling policy/settings UI. Material extra paths or remaining-estimate overrun require reassessment/deviation before continuing.
